validation_selection.selection: clean validation top-1 only; earliest epoch on within-run ties

source_dataset.ordering: Unchanged source row order within each split
source_dataset.pixels: Unchanged uint8 values; unpacked from channel-plane to NHWC RGB layout
source_dataset.label_space: Fine labels 0–99 in original integer encoding

corruption.name: Local paired Gaussian blur on CIFAR-100
corruption.normalized_kernel: exp(-0.5 * (coordinates / sigma) ** 2) normalized to sum to one
corruption.boundary: SciPy mirror (whole-sample symmetric, duplicating no edge pixel; OpenCV REFLECT_101 semantics)
corruption.computation: Binary64 scalar channels, then np.rint ties-to-even output to uint8

clean.dataset: CIFAR-100 official train and test split, fine classes
clean.selection_rule: highest validation top-1 accuracy, earliest checkpoint on ties
clean.architecture: compact native 32px residual CNN with three max-pool residual stages
clean.augmentation: per-image 4px reflection-padded random crop and horizontal flip
clean.precision_embeddings: float32 with CUDA TF32 convolution enabled
clean.optimizer: SGD Nesterov(momentum=.9, weight_decay=.0005), 2 epochs warmup then cosine
